business_problem: Amgen, one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies, is known for pioneering biologics for serious diseases.
solution_summary: Amgen rolled out Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 across its Microsoft 365 estate because Amgen, one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies, is known for pioneering biologics for serious diseases. Users work inside applications such as Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365, where the assistant can summarize meetings and email, draft documents, surface answers from existing files and conversations, and help employees move from context gathering to action without switching tools. Rather than building a separate chatbot, the organization grounded AI in the same collaboration data, permissions, and operational workflows that staff already use every day, which keeps adoption and governance aligned. The result is a reusable productivity layer for knowledge work and service delivery, and This strategic use of AI not only has the potential to speed up drug development but also supports advancements in Amgen’s business processes.
